mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% in a month, the S&P 500 forward 20-day return is expected to be negative due to tightened financing conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the trigger (p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS rise is ≤0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) by at least 50,000 jobs is associated with a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days, reflecting stronger labor market confidence.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥50,000 in a month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or non-significant (p > 0.05) despite the labor signal.

mechanism_narrative: When both HOUST (residential construction) and GDPC1 (personal consumption) show double-digit month-over-month growth, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is predicted to be positive, signaling robust demand momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth >10% and GDPC1 growth >10% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the interaction.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of at least 3% predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days, indicating weakening supply-side activity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative or the signal is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime where UNRATE falls below 3%, the S&P 500 60-day forward return is expected to be positive due to lower real interest rates and increased equity valuation sensitivity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the regime.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) exceeds 400,000 thousand dollars in a month, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is predicted to be positive, reflecting consumer spending strength.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive or not statistically significant during the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of CPIAUCSL inflation above 2% are associated with a negative S&P 500 60-day forward return, as the market anticipates policy rate hikes that dampen growth expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negative or inflation does not persist above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When both INDPRO and GDPC1 show simultaneous declines of at least 5% in a month, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is predicted to be negative, reflecting dual supply-side weakness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by ≥5% and GDPC1 decreases by ≥5% in the same month
regime_hint: dual contraction in output and consumption
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative or the interaction is not statistically significant.
